title: Here’s Why You Don’t Threaten Random People When You Have A Warrant
description:
#news #police #arrest

On June 9th, 2023. An officer was dispatched to an apartment complex due to a man threatening people with box cutters. When the officer located the man and I.D him, he had a warrant for aggravated assault in another county.  The man also started calling officers "gay" & "f*g" when they were searching him. He also wanted to start a fight with one of the officers. The man was identified as Roberto.
